meta.name: json-canvas
meta.description: Create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas) with nodes, edges, groups, and connections. Use when working with .canvas files, creating visual canvases, mind maps, flowcharts, or when the user mentions Canvas files in Obsidian.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和编辑 JSON Canvas 文件，构建可视化画布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Obsidian 中创建和编辑 .canvas 文件
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit JSON Canvas files for visual canvases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and edit .canvas files in Obsidian

howto.what: Claude 能按 JSON Canvas 规范创建和编辑 .canvas 文件，生成含文本、文件、链接、分组等节点及其连线关系的画布数据。
howto.when: 当你提到 .canvas 文件、思维导图、流程图等视觉画布，或提到 Obsidian 的 Canvas 文件时触发。

say.text: 创建一张 .canvas 画布，包含一个中心节点和两个子节点，用箭头连接。
say.note: 生成符合规范的 JSON 数据。

say.text: 把这两个节点用边连起来，边上加上标签“支持”。
say.note: 会添加一条带标签的边。

say.text: 帮我生成一个项目看板的 .canvas 文件，用三个分组表示待办、进行中和完成。

howto.what_en: Claude can create and edit .canvas files following the JSON Canvas spec, producing canvas data with nodes (text, file, link, group) and connecting edges.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention .canvas files, ask to create visual canvases like mind maps or flowcharts, or refer to Canvas files in Obsidian.

say_en.text: Create a .canvas file with one central node and two child nodes connected by arrows.
Connect these two nodes with an edge labeled 'supports'.
Generate a .canvas project board with three groups: To Do, In Progress, Done.
